name: BooKoo Scales Driver
author: Roy Ackerman; Decaid contributors
description: BooKoo Themis Mini and Ultra BLE scales with firmware-specific shutdown and keep-awake options.

PowerCommandSupport.label: Power command compatibility
PowerCommandSupport.description: Choose Disabled for older/unknown firmware, Shutdown only for Ultra v4.0.0, or Shutdown and keep-awake for Ultra v4.0.1+ / Mini v1.4.2+. Applies to every scale connected by this plugin. Legacy Mini setting preserves the previous firmware checkbox.

Firmware142Commands.label: Mini v1.4.2 power commands (legacy setting)
Firmware142Commands.description: Used only when Power command compatibility is Legacy Mini setting. Existing Mini users keep their saved choice. Leave off on Mini v1.4.1. Use the compatibility selector for Ultra firmware; this checkbox does not detect model or firmware.

KeepAwake.label: Keep scale awake while connected
KeepAwake.description: Requires Shutdown and keep-awake compatibility (Ultra v4.0.1+ or Mini v1.4.2+). Resets auto-off on connection and every 60 seconds. Enable Decaid scale power management to disconnect when the machine sleeps.

PowerOffOnDisconnect.label: Power off on intentional disconnect
PowerOffOnDisconnect.description: Requires Shutdown only or Shutdown and keep-awake compatibility. Sends shutdown before a healthy scale disconnects, including machine sleep, manual disconnect and switching scales. Unload/reload and failures skip shutdown. Ultra shutdown is unavailable while charging.

PacketTimeoutMs.label: Weight notification timeout (milliseconds)
PacketTimeoutMs.description: Reports a lost protocol stream to Decaid after this many milliseconds without a valid weight packet. Default 2000; allowed range 1000 to 30000. Increase only if hardware testing shows a slower normal notification cadence.
